'''Karin Nanami''' (Japanese: '''奈波果林''' ''Nanami Karin'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
As an adult, Nanami became a voice actress and was involved with a few anime series. She became involved with the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, voicing [[Team Flare]] scientist [[Celosia]] as well as [[Lucianne]], one of [[Baraz]] and [[Meray]]'s childhood friends from [[Arche Valley]]. In addition, Nanami voiced {{pokken|Elinn}}, a character in [[Pokkén Tournament]].
